how.title: From one search to a list you can work with.
how.intro: Three steps. Everything else, like review analysis or social profile lookup, is optional and runs on the batch you already have.

steps.title: Pick an industry and area
steps.text: Type one or more keywords and choose a country, province and district. Only the country is required.

steps.title: Set the batch size
steps.text: Ask for up to 150 businesses per search. The cap holds even when you use several keywords.

steps.title: Review and export
steps.text: See everything in one sheet, analyze what matters to you, and download the batch as CSV or XLSX.

data.title: What every lead includes.
data.text: Each row combines Google Maps data with what Leadta adds afterwards. If a value doesn't exist, the cell stays empty and the column stays in place, so your exports always have the same format.

pains.title: Know what hurts each business before you write to it.
pains.text: Leadta reads the saved reviews of each lead and summarizes the problems that keep coming up. Every finding quotes the review that backs it.

reviews.quote: I called three times and nobody picked up. I had to go to the clinic to book.
Great with the animals, but we waited almost two hours with an appointment.
I couldn't find prices anywhere, I only found out at the counter.

pains.honest: If a business has no readable reviews, Leadta doesn't make up pain points: it tells you it couldn't analyze it.
pains.enrichText: Choose the networks you care about and Leadta looks for each business's official profile. Only the links it finds are saved, and each network gets its own column.
pains.credit: Pain point analysis adds 0.5 credits per analyzed lead.

export.title: Export it, and come back whenever you want.
export.text: Every search is saved as a batch in your private history. Reopen it and download it again whenever you need.
points: CSV or XLSX downloads with every column, empty ones included.
Private history: only you see your batches and leads.
Add analysis and socials later on any batch.

credits for every lead in your search

items.q: Where do the businesses come from?
items.a: From Google Maps. You search by industry and area and Leadta brings back businesses with the public details on their listing.

items.q: Do leads always have a phone and email?
items.a: No. If Google Maps or the business's website doesn't publish a detail, the cell stays empty. We never fill gaps with made-up data.
Leadta analyzes each business's saved reviews, and every finding quotes the review behind it. With no readable reviews, there are no findings.

items.q: How many leads does a plan give me?
items.a: Each lead uses 2 credits. With 500 credits you get up to 250 leads, and pain point analysis adds 0.5 credits per analyzed lead.

items.q: Can I repeat a search in the same area?
items.a: Yes. Leadta remembers the businesses it already returned for that area so later searches bring you new results.
Yes. Every account has its own history, and nobody else sees your batches or leads.
